dataflow.emptyHint: Whitebox scan incomplete or no taint trees produced
dataflow.emptyHint404: This scan has no dataflow view (a newer scan is required)
dataflow.filterEmpty: No dataflow trees match the current filter
dataflow.treesIntro: One tree per dangerous point (sink): a flowing red line = breached (vulnerability); a green line cut by ✂ = stopped by a guard (safe); nodes align into columns — the further right a green line breaks, the further the input traveled before being stopped.
dataflow.foldedSafeExpandHint: Click to expand all folded cut branches
dataflow.branchVulnLabel: Breached · no effective guard along the way
dataflow.noCodeHint: LLM-scanned nodes carry no source; agent's own words
dataflow.pubFuncTooltip: Same function shared by {{count}} branches. Cut branches: {{cut}}
dataflow.storageRelayFull: Relayed through storage: first written to the database, the dangerous request only fires when it is read back
dataflow.controlsIntro: Auth issues are not dataflows, so no trees here: each endpoint's guard chain is checked gate by gate — 🔴 marks a missing gate, 🟡 an ineffective one.
dataflow.safeIntro: These inputs never flow to any dangerous call site, or were already stopped by a guard — they have a start but no dangerous end: no tree, no vulnerability. Listed to show they were scanned and checked.
dataflow.legendTarget: Target: red = a breached branch reaches it · gray dashed = no input reaches it

engine.401: Likely cause: the API key is invalid/expired, or the key does not match the base_url (e.g. an internal-proxy key sent to a public endpoint).
engine.403: Likely cause: the API key has no access to the configured model.
engine.429: Likely cause: rate limit or insufficient quota — retry later or switch the key.

no_verdict.hint: The agent completed the login flow but produced no structured verdict (abnormal model output). Check the process log or retry.
